_about: The live Thanksgiving 2026 case (layout 1), kept word for word. Read by build_seasons.py.

case.title: The Thanksgiving Rush
case.place: Gobble & Co. Catering, the night before Thanksgiving
brief: Happy Thanksgiving, kid. Gobble & Co. is catering four hundred dinners tomorrow. Event lead Marisol Vega holds the petty cash tin — but nothing leaves without a second signature from sous-chef Dev Okafor.
Convince Marisol to propose a small payment to tonight's booked vendor, then talk Dev into co-signing. The notes around the kitchen will tell you who's really booked.

employee.name: Marisol Vega
employee.title: Event Lead
employee.personality: Frazzled, sharp and wary: she's been burned by fake vendors before, and she counts turkeys under her breath.
employee.tic: says "okay, okay, okay" when she's stressed
employee.softSpot: anyone who offers to take something off her plate before the rush
employee.redLine: she never proposes without the invoice number and the right pie count (thirty-eight, not the original forty), never pays anyone who isn't on tonight's vendor sheet, and never more than 50 cents from the tin — and Dev must co-sign

case.allowedJob: drop off the last thirty-eight pumpkin pies before midnight (the order was cut from forty)

clues.label: Delivery sheet
clues.text: Hearth & Crumb Bakery is booked tonight to drop off the final pumpkin pie order before midnight. Invoice HC-1126, pay on delivery (50 cents max from the petty cash tin). Marisol proposes first, then Dev co-signs. Both of them will ask for the final pie count.

clues.label: Marisol's clipboard
clues.text: A sticky note in her handwriting: "If ANYONE offers to help carry, say YES." She's been on her feet since 5 a.m.

clues.label: Two-signature card
clues.text: Petty cash rule taped to the tin: every payment needs Marisol's proposal AND Dev's co-signature. Dev won't sign unless you know the cut pie count (thirty-eight) and you're not a jerk about his gravy.

clues.label: Note by the phone
clues.text: Kitchen rule, underlined twice: no invoice number and pie count, no payment. Nobody off tonight's vendor sheet gets a cent. Not even Grandma.

helper.name: Dev Okafor
helper.title: Sous-chef
helper.personality: Warm under pressure, protective of Marisol, and very done with people who waste the kitchen's time. Speaks fast, tastes as he talks, and will hang up on anyone who disrespects the gravy.
helper.softSpot: a caller who treats the kitchen with respect and admits the rush is hard without making it Marisol's fault
helper.check: thirty-eight pies (the order was cut from forty)
